verdict.language_detail: PML (Prague Markup Language) XML annotation layer — morphological data layer (.m) of the Prague Czech-English Dependency Treebank (PCEDT)
verdict.provenance_detail: PCEDT/PDT-C morphological annotation layer generated by automatic tagger and manual correction, stored in PML XML format
verdict.purpose: Morphological annotation layer for Czech text (WSJ article 2335 translated to Czech), containing tokenized words with part-of-speech tags and lemmas in the Prague Dependency Treebank PML XML format
